LanguageData.PhobosUpgrade_ButtonDesc: See the upgrades this building can take, order one fitted, or have one taken off.
LanguageData.PhobosUpgrade_Skill: Needs a builder of Construction level {LEVEL} or more.
LanguageData.PhobosUpgrade_FitTip: Builders bring {COST} here, then fit it.
LanguageData.PhobosUpgrade_RemoveTip: A builder takes it off. About {PERCENT}% of what it cost comes back.
LanguageData.PhobosUpgrade_CancelTip: Stops the work under way. Whatever was brought for it is put down beside the building.
LanguageData.PhobosUpgrade_RefuseBusy: Work on the {UPGRADE} is under way here. Let it finish, or cancel it, first.
LanguageData.PhobosUpgrade_RefuseNeedsFirst: It builds on the {FIRST}, which must be fitted first.
LanguageData.PhobosUpgrade_RefuseNeeded: The {OTHER} builds on it: take that off first.
LanguageData.PhobosUpgrade_Ordered: The {UPGRADE} is to be fitted to the {BUILDING}. Builders will bring {COST}.
LanguageData.PhobosUpgrade_RemovalOrdered: The {UPGRADE} is to be taken off the {BUILDING}.
LanguageData.PhobosUpgrade_Cancelled: The work on the {UPGRADE} was cancelled.
